messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: tenant_request_rate_sla_breach for tenant=brightleaf triggered (p95 latency > 350ms, sustained 7m). Incident ID INC-2029-67.
ops-bot: Stack: inference-prod-us-east-1, route: /v1/generate, approx affected qps=12. Link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-2029-67
alex: oncall here, looking. first check: are these real user requests or synthetic?
morgan: real traffic, customer (brightleaf) on Dedicated pool 3. Saw spike after their batch re-try yesterday.
jamie: grabbing logs, will tail gateway and runtime. running: `kubectl logs -n inference svc/gateway --tail=200`
nisha: FYI I already muted non-customer noise alerts for unrelated heartbeat checks. we need to avoid global muting.
alex: ok, priority: 1) verify customer impact 2) mitigate to stop paging 3) postmortem actions (dashboard + alert tuning).
morgan: quick query (Grafana):
```
sum by (tenant) (rate(request_latency_bucket{le="0.35"}[10m])) / sum by (tenant) (rate(request_count[10m]))
```
results: brightleaf p95 is ~420ms for last 10m. others fine.
jamie: runtime logs show repeated model cache misses and KV cache thrash for their sessions. suspect large context windows + small batch sizing.
alex: can we route brightleaf to a lower-cost model variant temporarily (faster kv layout)?
morgan: yes, we have model_variant=v2-quant-fast compatible. I'll create a temporary routing rule.
morgan: applying routing override: `redctl route set --tenant brightleaf --model v2-quant-fast --until 2025-12-08T19:00:00Z`
ops-bot: Route change accepted. New requests should be routed within ~30s.
jamie: latency dropped to p95 ~210ms after override. :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: Marking alert as acknowledged by alex.
alex: nice. But we still paged — need to tune alert to avoid repeats. Proposal: change the tenant-specific check to require 5m sustained >350ms AND >2% of global qps. Also add a suppressed-window for known batch jobs between 02:00-03:00 UTC.
nisha: agreed on sustained window. For suppression schedule, let's be careful — brightleaf runs some nightly imports at 02:15 UTC occasionally. We should detect re-tries instead of blanket suppression.
morgan: here's the current alert rule: `expr: tenant_p95_latency{tenant="$tenant"} > 0.35` -> fires immediately. I'll propose replacement: `avg_over_time(tenant_p95_latency{tenant="$tenant"}[5m]) > 0.35 and increase_rate(tenant_requests{tenant="$tenant"}[5m]) > 0.02`
ajam: (typo) jamie: we should also add a cooldown so it doesn't page more than once per 20m.
alex: agree. Add a template message explaining impact and include sample dashboard link.
morgan: creating PR in infra-alerts to replace rule for tenant-specific p95: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pull/894 (WIP). I'll include the cooldown.
jamie: meanwhile I created a temporary dashboard panel (WG: brightleaf-sla-dash) showing p50/p95/p99, request rate, model-variant, and KV cache hit ratio. Link: https://grafana.redwood/d/brightleaf/tenant-sla-dash
nisha: add annotation to dashboard for the routing override and the PR link.
ops-bot: Note: we also need to update runbook: /playbooks/tenant-sla.md -> add step to consider model routing before scaling pods.
alex: follow-ups for post-incident: 1) merge alert rule PR 2) make permanent dashboard with alert templates 3) add a scheduled job to detect large batch retries and surface them to customers 4) update canary tests for tenant-level synthetic traffic.
morgan: I'll own PR and dashboard (morgan). Jamie will own investigating KV thrash root cause. Nisha will own runbook updates and postmortem writeup. Alex will own communication to account team and confirm SLA exposure.
jamie: root cause notes so far: brightleaf uses long-prompts + partial retry loop client-side, causing repeated cold KV usage. Proposed runtime fix: increase caching window for streaming sessions and bump batch size heuristics for long-context sessions.
alex: can we push a quick runtime config change to increase KV cache TTL for Dedicated pool 3? risk low.
jamie: yes, patching: `cfgctl set runtime.kv.ttl --pool dedicated-3 --value 300s`
ops-bot: Runtime config change applied (audit id cfg-7782).
morgan: monitoring shows p95 stable ~190ms for last 10m, requests back to normal.
sre-bot: Closing the immediate incident (INC-2029-67) and flagging for follow-up.
alex: thanks team. Please put estimated customer SLA exposure in the postmortem draft. Account notified: @accounts-team.
nisha: draft done: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/INC-2029-67-draft (please add notes on alert rule delta and dashboard links).
jamie: opening a follow-up ticket to implement runtime caching improvements and add unit tests for retry detection: PROJ-4123.
morgan: PR for alert rule merged and deployed to prod (commit 7a9c3d).
alex: nice work. Closing thread. :tada:
